name: Manage AKS Application

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:

      action:
        description: "Select the operation"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - increase
          - decrease

      replicas:
        description: "Replica count (1 to 5 only)"
        required: true
        type: number

env:
  RESOURCE_GROUP: my-aks-rg
  AKS_CLUSTER: my-aks-cluster
  DEPLOYMENT_NAME: webapp-html

jobs:

  manage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      # 1. Checkout repository
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Login to Azure
      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      # 3. Connect to AKS
      - name: Set AKS Context
        uses: azure/aks-set-context@v4
        with:
          resource-group: ${{ env.RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          cluster-name: ${{ env.AKS_CLUSTER }}

      # 4. Setup kubectl
      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4

      # 5. Check AKS connection
      - name: Check AKS
        run: |
          echo "Connected to AKS"
          kubectl cluster-info
          echo ""
          kubectl get nodes

      # 6. Validate replica count
      - name: Validate Replica Count
        run: |
          REPLICAS="${{ inputs.replicas }}"

          echo "Requested replicas: $REPLICAS"

          # Must contain only digits
          if ! [[ "$REPLICAS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Replica count must be a whole number."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Only 1 to 5 replicas are allowed
          if [ "$REPLICAS" -lt 1 ] || [ "$REPLICAS" -gt 5 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Only 1 to 5 replicas are allowed."
            echo "Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Valid replica count: $REPLICAS"

      # 7. Scale Deployment
      - name: Scale Deployment
        run: |
          ACTION="${{ inputs.action }}"
          REPLICAS="${{ inputs.replicas }}"

          echo "======================================"
          echo "AKS Replica Management"
          echo "======================================"

          echo "Action     : $ACTION"
          echo "Replicas   : $REPLICAS"
          echo "Deployment : ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}"

          if [ "$ACTION" = "increase" ]; then

            echo "Increasing replicas to $REPLICAS..."

            kubectl scale deployment \
              "${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}" \
              --replicas="$REPLICAS"

          elif [ "$ACTION" = "decrease" ]; then

            echo "Decreasing replicas to $REPLICAS..."

            kubectl scale deployment \
              "${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}" \
              --replicas="$REPLICAS"

          else

            echo "ERROR: Invalid action."
            exit 1

          fi

      # 8. Wait for rollout
      - name: Wait for Rollout
        run: |
          kubectl rollout status \
            deployment/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_NAME }} \
            --timeout=120s

      # 9. Verify final state
      - name: Verify Application
        run: |

          echo "======================================"
          echo "Deployment"
          echo "======================================"

          kubectl get deployment \
            "${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}"

          echo ""
          echo "======================================"
          echo "Pods"
          echo "======================================"

          kubectl get pods

          echo ""
          echo "======================================"
          echo "Services"
          echo "======================================"

          kubectl get services
